couple.tagline: The Imperial Mughal Wedding Celebration Of
couple.invitationMessage: With the divine grace and blessings of Almighty Allah (SWT) and the cherished prayers of our beloved parents and elders, we request the honour of your gracious presence and heartfelt duas as we celebrate the sacred union of our beloved children.
couple.urduGreeting: آپ کی شرکت ہمارے لیے باعثِ مسرت ہوگی

sacred.bismillahTranslation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
sacred.quranArabic: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً
sacred.surahArRum: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy.
sacred.familyDua: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا، وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا
sacred.closingDua: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكُمَا وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكُمَا وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
sacred.urduBlessing: آپ کی شرکت ہمارے لیے باعثِ مسرت ہوگی
